rss.title: Danger! Slippery Winter Marble Race! :)
rss.desc:
Race 19 of Season 25! It's winter, it's slippery out there! This is one of those marble races where we know that not every marble is going to see the finish line. It is a high-speed track featuring an ICE SLIDE and a SKI JUMP!

The stakes are high now. This is the penultimate race of the season, with only race 20 still to go. Team Yellow and Team Red are in a in a close battle for the points lead, with Green and White both threatening to catch up. 

Pick your color! Good Luck!

Creation Process:
My marble races are hand-created by me in Blender (3D animation software). It is not AI. I hand-build the tracks, I spend many hours each week creating marble designs, I manually add all the camera keyframes etc. On average it takes me around 100 hours to create one video. The race outcomes are determined by simulated physics built into the software, not by me! :)
Additional graphics created by me in Affinity Designer. I sometimes use stock images from Poly Haven, Pexels and Pixabay when creating new textures. For more details, some of my videos include a "behind-the-scenes" section at the end, showing the Blender build process. :)

Technical Details:
3D Software: Blender 4.0, using rigid body animation. (Yes, I still use Blender 4.0, because I prefer the older EEVEE render engine!)
Render Engine: EEVEE
Render Specs: 4K UHDTV, 60 frames per second.
2D Software: Affinity Designer 2
Final Editing: Blender 4.0 (and sometimes Davinci Resolve)
Time per video (rough avg.): 40 hours for 3D modelling, 10 hours physics testing, 2 hours camera keyframing, 20 to 30 hours rendering, 20 hours for sound and final editing.

rss.title: Countries Marble Race!!!
rss.desc:
It is here!!! The first ever MoreBalls Countries Marble Race! This is a big, elimination style race. The last marble to arrive at each checkpoint is out and the first two to arrive at the finish line qualify for the final race! Five qualifier races, so that means ten marbles in the final.

There are ten countries represented, in order of appearance they are France, Australia, USA, Germany, Canada, Argentina, Brazil, UK, Mexico and Spain. I picked these ten countries because these are the countries where most (and/or the most loyal) MoreBalls fans reside! The lane assignment is random.

I thought about having 50 countries so that we can have a different 10 in each qualifier, but I decided against it. This video is a hat-tip to our biggest fans. We will try 50 countries in a future race! 

This is just a fun, exhibition race, not part of the ongoing season 26. No political commentary intended, the outcome is random, but feel free to interpret the racing as you see fit. :) Angry comments are welcome. Tell me what you really think. ;)

rss.title: *EPIC* Elimination Race. Season 26, Marble Race 18
rss.desc:
Welcome to RACE 18 of Season 26!!

This one is epic! It is an elimination race and because White is the defending champ I built the entire race with a white theme. This is an all-new track, new marble designs and new races. The format is familiar: Five qualifier races where the top two marbles move on to compete in the final race. Stay tuned after the final race for outtakes and a look behind the scenes, including the graphic design production in Affinity Designer and the 3D modelling and animation in Blender.

The Season:
We are close to the end of season 26 now, with only two races remaining after this one. The competition is intense, with Red, Yellow and Green leading. Team White has been the surprise, moving up to fourth place in the season ranking after a very slow start to the season.

rss.title: Rocketball!! - MoreBalls Marble Race  | Season 26 Race 17
rss.desc:
Season 26 Race 17! This is a technically complex marble race. I have been experimenting, creating different kinds of light trails to use on the marbles in a night race. In this 5-race championship I used five awesome light trail effects, created using Geometry Nodes in Blender. Please let me know which of the light trails you prefer!

The season is nearing the end now! This is Race 17 of this season, only three races remaining after this one! The standings going into this race are:
Red 328
Yellow 281
Green 266
Pink 156
Blue 156
Black 156
White 141
Purple 125
Cyan 109
Orange 31

Really close between the top three teams, Red Yellow and Green. Whoever finishes strongest will probably take the season crown from Cyan who won in season 25! 

Five Races today, points for the top 5 finishers! And introducing Rocketball! Today's race is timed and whoever gets the fastest time of the day is the rocketball and receives the three-point rocketball bonus! :)

Pick your color and good luck! May the best marble win!

rss.title: Elimination Race! Big new wood-themed marble elimination race.
rss.desc:
Elimination Race Time!! Welcome to Race 16 of Season 26! This is a big, new race track, a new race and, as always, all new marble designs. I had a lot of fun with this one, especially the technical, mechanical challenge for the spinning checkpoints... you'll see what I mean! This is an elimination race, with checkpoints where the last marble to arrive is eliminated until we have only three marbles left at the finish line. The top two of those finishers qualify for the final race. There are five qualifier races to fill the roster of ten marbles (colors) in the final race.

The season so far:
The standings at the start of this race are:
Red 350
Yellow 300
Green 217
Pink 167
Blue 167
Black 167
White 150
Cyan 117
Purple 100
Orange 017
Red won the last race, which saw it moving back up to the top of the points table for the season, displacing Yellow, again! Orange continues to sit right at the bottom of the table, no longer on zero points but very far behind and unlikely to mount a comeback with only a handful of races remaining in this season. Right now the plan is to complete 20 races this season, and we are already on Race 16!

The points system is one point for first, 0.5 for second and 0.25 for third. The points are then divided by the number of races competed in, to allow for the possibility that not all teams will take part in every race. For the final display the decimal is dropped from the scores.

rss.title: *NEW* Night Marble Race - Capture the Flag!
rss.desc:
Capture the Flag, at NIGHT! This is Season 26, Marble Race 15! Let's go! Yellow and Red have been fighting hard for the points lead. Green not far behind in third place for the season so far!

Our second capture-the-flag race, this time at night. I am really happy with how the designs turned out in this one, both the marbles and the tracks. This race builds on the previous capture-the-flag race ideas, with lots of split paths with multiple flags, and walls of blocks to keep the racing tight. And it was a tight race, going down to the last stretch of the last race! Like last time, it is one point per flag and three points for this last flag - only this time the last flag is really three separate, tightly grouped flags which will potentially make for interesting finishes.

Pick your color and good luck! May the best marble win!

Watch to the end for outtakes and behind-the-scenes! :)

On average it takes me around 100 hours to create one video. The race outcomes are determined by simulated physics built into the software, not by me! :)
Additional graphics created by me in Affinity Designer. I sometimes use stock images from Poly Haven, Pexels and Pixabay when creating new textures.

Technical Details:
3D Software: Blender 4.0, using rigid body animation. (Yes, I still use Blender 4.0, because I prefer the older EEVEE render engine!)
Render Engine: EEVEE
Render Specs: 4K UHDTV, 60 frames per second.
2D Software: Affinity Designer 2
Final Editing: Blender 4.0 (and sometimes Davinci Resolve)
Time per video (rough avg.): 40 hours for 3D modelling, 10 hours physics testing, 2 hours camera keyframing, 20 to 30 hours rendering, 20 hours for sound and final editing.

Our FIRST EVER, MoreBalls Capture-the-Flag Marble Race! I'm excited about this format and I would love to hear what you think in the comments!

Pick your color and may the best marble win!

Yellow is still in the lead at the start of today's race. Red in second place has been closing the gap. Pink Green and Black all looking strong too. Orange, sadly, still with ZERO points this entire season. Race Control reports that the team Orange coach has been replaced and that Orange was spotted in the gym this week!
